en: A person who is receiving medical treatment; or able to wait calmly without getting angry.
ex: The nurse takes good care of every patient.
護理師細心照顧每一位病人。

en: Something given to a person who wins a competition or does something special; or to value something highly.
ex: She won first prize in the speech contest.
她在演講比賽中得了第一名。

en: To get away from a place or a danger; or the act of getting away.
ex: The prisoner escaped from the jail last night.
那名囚犯昨晚從監獄逃走了。

en: To make someone healthy again after an illness; or a medicine or treatment that makes someone better.
ex: Doctors are trying to find a cure for the disease.
醫生們正努力尋找治療這種疾病的方法。

en: The number 1,000,000,000, which is one thousand million.
ex: The population of the world is over eight billion.
世界人口超過八十億。

en: The total number of people living in a place; or all the people living in a city or country.
ex: The population of the city is about two million.
這座城市的人口大約兩百萬。

en: A way out of a building or a place; or to leave a place.
ex: Please use the emergency exit in case of fire.
發生火災時請使用緊急出口。

en: To think of someone or something in a particular way; or respect; or to look at someone or something.
ex: They regard him as the best teacher in the school.
他們把他視為學校裡最好的老師。

en: Making no sound; or not speaking; or not expressing opinions.
ex: The room was silent when the teacher walked in.
老師走進來時，房間一片安靜。

en: To curve something, or to be curved; or to lower your body forward; or a curve in a road.
ex: She bent down to pick up the keys from the floor.
她彎下腰撿起地上的鑰匙。

en: A set of plans or actions agreed on by a government or organization; or an insurance document.
ex: The school has a policy against bullying.
學校有禁止霸凌的政策。

en: Used to say that you agree or that something is true; or to answer a question in a positive way.
ex: Yes, I would like a cup of tea, please.
是的，我想要一杯茶，謝謝。

en: The conditions outside, such as sun, rain, wind or snow; or to survive a difficult situation.
ex: The weather is cold and rainy today.
今天天氣又冷又下雨。

en: Producing the result that you want; or working well; or in operation.
ex: This is an effective way to learn new words.
這是學習新單字的有效方法。

en: A structure with walls and a roof, such as a house, school or office; or the act of constructing.
ex: There is a tall building next to our school.
我們學校隔壁有一棟高樓。

en: A piece of glass in which you can see yourself; or to show the same thing as something else.
ex: She looked at herself in the mirror and smiled.
她看著鏡中的自己微笑了。

en: An example of something; or a particular situation; or a time when something happens.
ex: For instance, you could take a walk after dinner.
例如，晚餐後你可以去散步。

en: To say that something is not true; or to refuse to give someone something.
ex: He denied that he had broken the window.
他否認窗戶是他打破的。

en: A machine that burns fuel to produce power to move a vehicle; or the front part of a train.
ex: The mechanic fixed the car's engine.
技師修好了車子的引擎。

en: The head of a country or a company; or the leader of an organization or a university.
ph: the President of the United States
ex: The president gave a speech to the nation.
總統向全國發表了演說。

en: A piece of paper that shows how much you owe for goods or services; or paper money; or a proposed law.
ex: Could we have the bill, please?
請給我們帳單好嗎？

en: The top layer of the ground in which plants grow; or to make something dirty.
ex: The plants grow well in rich, dark soil.
植物在肥沃的黑土裡生長良好。

en: To move something down; or to make something less; or at a lower level.
ex: Please lower your voice in the library.
在圖書館請放低音量。

en: The smallest living part of an animal or plant; or a small room in a prison; or a unit in a battery.
ex: All living things are made of cells.
所有生物都由細胞組成。

en: To become healthy again after an illness; or to get back something you lost.
ex: He is slowly recovering from the flu.
他正在慢慢從流感中恢復。

en: Air that moves outside; or to turn something around and around; or to follow a twisting path.
ex: A cold wind blew across the field.
一陣冷風吹過田野。

en: A soft, sweet food made with milk, eggs and sugar, usually eaten after a meal.
ex: We had chocolate pudding for dessert.
我們甜點吃巧克力布丁。

en: To move something to a higher position; or a machine that carries people between floors; or a free ride in a car.
ex: He lifted the heavy box onto the shelf.
他把沉重的箱子舉到架子上。

en: To move your hand or a cloth over a surface with pressure; or to clean or dry something by doing this.
ex: She rubbed her hands together to keep warm.
她搓著雙手取暖。

en: To find something or learn something for the first time; or to find a place or person.
ex: Scientists discovered a new species of frog.
科學家發現了一種新的青蛙。

en: A formal discussion in which people give different opinions; or to talk about something in this way.
ex: Our class had a debate about school uniforms.
我們班上舉行了一場關於制服的辯論。

en: The food that you usually eat; or a special plan of eating to lose weight; or to eat less to become thinner.
ex: A healthy diet includes lots of fruit and vegetables.
健康的飲食包括大量的水果和蔬菜。

en: A very large area of salt water that covers a large part of the Earth.
ex: The ship sailed across the Pacific Ocean.
那艘船橫渡太平洋。

en: To help someone or something succeed; or to hold the weight of something; or to provide money for someone.
ex: My parents always support my decisions.
我的父母總是支持我的決定。

en: A small animal like a large mouse with a long tail; or a dishonest person.
ex: A rat ran across the kitchen floor.
一隻老鼠跑過廚房的地板。

en: The way two people or things are connected; or a member of your family; or an account of events.
ex: There is a close relation between exercise and health.
運動與健康有密切的關係。

en: A raised area in a train station where passengers wait; or a raised flat surface for speakers; or a computer system.
ex: The train will arrive at platform three.
火車將抵達第三月台。

en: To look at something for a period of time; or to pay attention to something; or a small clock worn on your wrist.
ex: We watched a film at the cinema last night.
我們昨晚在電影院看了一部電影。

en: Not correct; not true; or morally bad; or in a way that is not correct.
ex: I took the wrong bus and got lost.
我搭錯了公車，迷路了。

en: Willing to give money, time or help freely; or larger than usual.
ex: She is very generous and often gives money to charity.
她非常慷慨，常常捐錢給慈善機構。
